entry.name: AI Engineering in Python
entry.note: A project-based learning path with a completion certificate, not a proctored exam
entry.audience: Career changers who want to learn by building projects

covers: Command line, Git, and virtual environments
reading.format: Hands-on learning in the browser with code feedback, guided projects involving realistic business scenarios, and portfolio building.
reading.summary: This path teaches technical skills for AI engineering, including Python programming, working with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and deploying AI applications with FastAPI and Docker. It also covers machine learning, deep learning with PyTorch, embeddings, vector databases, and RAG systems. Completing the path shows ability to build and deploy AI applications and includes guided projects for a portfolio.
reading.audience: It is for learners who want to build AI engineering skills, starting from Python fundamentals and progressing to production AI systems.
